name: r2-dispatch-manual-cloud-fault
_comment: Cloud broker traffic of manual STREGA commands that are not accepted: ChirpStack enqueue failures (INVALID_ARGUMENT, UNAVAILABLE, and an INVALID_ARGUMENT whose details say invalid, which the ledger stores as REJECTED_PERMANENT), a non-16-hex key (open and timed close) and a valve held by a RESERVED conditional occurrence, then an accepted control.
